block.comment: Choose input/output direction for the selected AVR port bits. Other bits are preserved. This is hardware-specific; use the board diagram to identify the affected pins.

Purpose: Blink D13 through AVR port registers. Compare the generated code and Flash use with ordinary digitalWrite. Wiring: Only the Pro Mini; PB5 is the built-in L / D13 LED. Try: Change the wait times; PB5 is the built-in D13 LED.
Wait for the given number of milliseconds (1000 ms = 1 second). This pauses the main program; avoid long waits when loop must service motors, music files or serial input.
Change a single AVR output bit directly. Set its direction to output first. Direct register operations bypass the usual digitalWrite overhead.
